correctness.rationale: For every m>=2, positive alpha,beta,gamma, kappa, s and budget in the stated bound, the epidemiological matrix is symmetric irreducible Metzler, hence has simple positive Perron eigenvector. The symmetric largest eigenvalue is strictly convex on the fixed-budget hyperplane: vanishing second variation would require diagonal perturbation scalar, impossible under a nonzero zero-sum budget direction. Leaf symmetry gives equality of all leaf allocations. Exact 2x2 compression, F second derivative >0, sign-retaining stationary-root solve, clipping, and substitution prove every case including endpoints and affine interior growth. The bundled independent Jacobi matrix diagonalization and exact Fraction cases returned VERIFY_OK 20706 assertions; finite checks corroborate but cannot replace the universal proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete closed-form, mathematically motivated resource-allocation classification in a standard geographic epidemic diffusion model. It identifies exactly when vaccination concentration at the high-effectiveness hub or evenly among weaker leaves ceases to be optimal, gives all equality conditions/unique optimum, the physical feasibility cutoff, and a surprising exact affine optimum after mixing begins, with direct use as a benchmark for network epidemic spectral interventions. It is not merely a single numerical point or a routine parameter substitution; classic eigenvalue ingredients do not trivially supply the sign-dependent phase boundaries.
